title: F24 · bad_day_home · The Slammed Door
lines: Bad day at the shop. And they were the nearest ones.
It was about a wet towel on the bed.
It was not about the towel.
He sat on the bed, still shaking, and hated the sound of his own voice.
Under the door, a piece of paper slid in.
And he remembered a picture from his childhood: a goddess, mid-rage, one foot on someone who had lain down in her way.
He opened the door. Pari was lying on the floor outside it. On purpose.
and said sorry to each of them. By name.
When love lies down in your path, stop. That is sadhana.
